# VGGT-Omega runtime subset

This vendored source provides the `vggt_omega` inference package used by FlowHMR for camera estimation. The upstream training, evaluation, and demo materials are omitted from the runtime tree.

Upstream project: https://github.com/facebookresearch/vggt-omega

Retain `LICENSE` and `DINOv3_LICENSE.md` when redistributing this source.
